notes: Candidates are real coordinates, not certified landing locations.
NASA 60 m averages describe long-term any-disc visibility; they are not the selected mission timeline or average electrical output.

Panel power uses Sun distance, area, efficiency, losses, pointing and a uniform-disc fraction above a locally straight horizon. One-minute midpoint power sampling; eclipses and thermal effects unmodeled.
Mission Earth bands use any portion of the Earth disc; Earth visibility does not establish a radio link.
Landing dates are explicit mission inputs. Launch-to-landing timing, transfer trajectory and flight reachability are not inferred.
Sensitivity cases are ±2× published RMS with disclosed coarse-terrain allowances; they are not strict bounds on reality.
Source-slope connected areas are measured only inside the 5 km mapped study patch.
Horizon rays use 0.25° azimuth spacing and 5/20/500 m radial steps to 300 km. Angular/radial aliasing remains possible.
Up to eight spatially separated terrain-screened locations are analyzed; the search is bounded, not exhaustive.
Visibility roots bracketed on the time grid are refined to one second. Panel mode uses one-minute sampling; constant power uses five minutes. Events wholly inside an interval may be missed.
All candidates require independent ground/obstacle and trajectory assessment.

geometry.correction: CN+S: converged light time and stellar aberration; no atmospheric refraction
geometry.observer: Actual surface position including DEM elevation and entered instrument height
geometry.visibility: Mission bands use the body centre unless Earth any-disc is selected. Panel power estimates a uniform solar-disc fraction above a locally straight horizon. Radio-link budgets and eclipses are not modeled.

screening.averagingPeriod: 18.6-year modeled cycle; exact start/end epochs are not specified in these labels.
screening.solarDefinition: Fraction of modeled timesteps with any part of the solar disc visible, not average electrical output.
screening.earthDefinition: Fraction of modeled timesteps with any part of Earth visible; does not establish DSN or radio-link availability.
screening.shadowDefinition: Permanent-shadow classification in the source model; no classification of local ground support.
screening.surface: Source surface/terrain model; changing instrument height does not modify the NASA averages.
screening.sampling: Nearest 60 m source pixel; no fabricated 5 m detail.
screening.limitations: Archived modeled screening products, including possible DEM artifacts. EXTRAs are not supported by PDS or the LOLA Science Team.
